title: Data-centric training enables meaningful interaction learning in protein–ligand binding affi nity prediction
authors: Matheus da Silva; Lincon Vidal; Isabella Guedes; Camila de Magalhães; Fábio Custódio; Laurent Dardenne
one_liner_zh: 该文研究蛋白质-配体结合亲和力预测的CNN评分函数，虽涉及分子互作建模，但对象为蛋白-配体而非蛋白-DNA，方法可迁移性有限，仅部分相关。
abstract: Predicting protein–ligand binding affi nity remains a fundamental challenge in drug discovery, where machine learning models often struggle with rotational sentitivity, overfi tting, and poor generalization. Here we present a CNN–based scoring function that achieves robust and stable performance through careful attention to training methodology rather than architectural complexity. We systematically evaluate data augmentation strategies and fi nd that random rotation, unlike commonly used 90-degree rotations, eff ectively mitigates rotational variance. We introduce molecular dropout, a simple regularization technique that reduces reliance on isolated protein or ligand features and promotes learning of intermolecular interactions. The resulting model generalizes across diverse test conditions, including time-based and structurally disjoint splits, and performs competitively on standard and external benchmarks. Through systematic ablation studies, error analysis, and interpretability experiments, we provide insights into model behaviour, highlighting the importance of data-centric design in developing reliable scoring functions.
abstract_zh: 预测蛋白质-配体结合亲和力仍是药物发现中的一项基本挑战，机器学习模型在此方面常常面临旋转敏感性、过拟合和泛化能力差的问题。在此，我们提出一种基于CNN的评分函数，通过关注训练方法而非架构复杂性，实现了稳健且稳定的性能。我们系统评估了数据增强策略，发现随机旋转，而非常用的90度旋转，能有效缓解旋转方差。我们引入了分子丢弃（molecular dropout），一种简单的正则化技术，可减少对孤立蛋白质或配体特征的依赖，并促进分子间相互作用的学习。所得模型在多种测试条件下均能良好泛化，包括基于时间和结构分离的划分，并在标准和外部基准上表现具有竞争力。通过系统的消融研究、误差分析和可解释性实验，我们提供了对模型行为的深入见解，强调了以数据为中心的设计在开发可靠评分函数中的重要性。
